description: Deployment methodology releasing software changes incrementally while monitoring real-time telemetry to limit blast radius.
Deployment pattern incrementally replacing instances of an old version with a new version across a cluster.
Strategy maintaining two identical environments, switching live network traffic instantly from Blue to Green.
Technique routing a small percentage of live user traffic to a new version before expanding to full deployment.
Maximum scope of end users or business operations impacted when a deployment failure occurs.
System action automatically reverting traffic to a previous stable version upon detecting metric threshold failures.
